skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong visual direction and polished implementation details.
skill.summary: Guides AI agents to design and build polished frontend interfaces with clear aesthetic direction.
skill.author: AgentWorkforce

security_audit.summary: The three static findings are false positives caused by design-focused wording in SKILL.md. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, command execution, or system reconnaissance behavior was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 describes creating distinctive frontend interfaces and does not instruct system inspection or data collection. The wording is aesthetic guidance, not reconnaissance behavior.
Line 30 discusses typography choices for visual design. It contains no request to enumerate system details, access files, or inspect the host environment.
Line 34 recommends background and texture techniques for frontend visuals. It does not direct the agent to gather environment information or perform reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Generic frontend output often looks repetitive and lacks product context. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished interfaces with stronger visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Frames frontend work around audience, purpose, tone, constraints, and differentiation.
Encourages complete HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or similar frontend implementation.
Guides typography, color, motion, layout, backgrounds, and visual detail decisions.
Pushes agents to avoid generic layouts, common palettes, and repetitive font choices.
Balances implementation complexity with the selected visual direction.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a reusable component library or design system package.
It does not include executable scripts, templates, images, or generated assets.
It cannot guarantee accessibility or performance without review of the final code.
It may produce bold designs that need adjustment for conservative brand systems.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Product Interface
use_cases.description: Create a visually distinct page or app screen from a short product brief.

use_cases.title: Improve AI-Generated UI Quality
use_cases.description: Move generated frontend work away from common layouts, fonts, and color patterns.
use_cases.target_user: Frontend developers using AI coding tools

use_cases.title: Explore Visual Directions
use_cases.description: Test several aesthetic approaches before selecting a direction for implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single polished screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a landing page for a small budgeting app. Make it functional, responsive, and visually distinctive.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Product Dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a practical application view.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a SaaS analytics dashboard. Prioritize dense information, clear hierarchy, refined typography, and realistic states.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Multiple Directions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for visual exploration before implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to propose three visual directions for an online art marketplace, then implement the strongest direction as a responsive homepage.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complex Interface System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with constraints and production expectations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a responsive editor interface for a no-code workflow tool. Include toolbars, panels, empty states, and polished interactions.

output_examples.input: Build a homepage for a boutique hotel booking site.
output_examples.output: A responsive homepage with an editorial visual style, distinctive typography, strong imagery, booking controls, and polished hover states.

output_examples.input: Create a dashboard for a developer monitoring tool.
output_examples.output: A focused dashboard with compact metrics, alert states, restrained motion, clear navigation, and a visual tone suited to daily technical use.

output_examples.input: Make a portfolio page for a ceramic artist.
output_examples.output: A crafted portfolio experience with tactile textures, gallery sections, custom color choices, and layout details tied to the artist context.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product purpose, technical stack, and brand constraints before requesting implementation.
Ask for real interface states, including empty, loading, error, and responsive views when relevant.
Review generated output for accessibility, performance, and maintainability before production use.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for vague beauty without product context or target users.
Do not accept generic gradients, stock layouts, or repeated font choices without critique.
Do not use the skill as a substitute for accessibility testing or design QA.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create polished frontend interfaces, pages, components, and app screens with stronger visual direction.

faq.question: Does it generate working code?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the AI agent to implement working frontend code when the user requests a build.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for marketing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide dashboards, tools, product screens, portfolios, and other frontend experiences.

faq.question: Does it include assets or templates?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a guidance file and does not ship images, component files, or scripts.

faq.question: Is the skill safe to inspect?
faq.answer: The reviewed file contains design instructions only, with no executable code or network behavior.
